verdict.rationale: Motion docs show it combines multiple calendar accounts (Outlook, Google, iCloud) into one unified interface and auto-schedules tasks/meetings across them, implying busy blocks sync across connected calendars, but there is no explicit documentation confirming two-way busy-block syncing specifically between separate 'work' and 'personal' calendar accounts to keep both in step. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-account busy-block sync mechanics, confirmation of two-way conflict prevention across distinct work/personal calendars, and independent/hands-on verification of this specific sync behavior.
